{{Quote|Rishi? I've heard of Rishi. It's a planet. Some kind of pirate resort? Sounds like a real dive. I've kinda always wanted to go.|[[Vette]]|<ref name="SOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Rishi''' was a tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]] which was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the avian [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Why you want to live in hot, humid lowlands? Mountains are much better.|A Rishii questions non-Rishii settlers' choice of home location|<ref name="DFRS" />}}
[[File:Surface_of_Rishi_Full.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The surface of Rishi]]
Rishi was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories, along the [[Manda Merchant Route]]. It was also the endpoint of the only well-traveled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] into the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]], the [[Zareca String]].<ref name="TEA" />

Rishi was the homeworld of the [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]], a winged [[Species/Legends|species]], who lived in nests on the mountains of Rishi.<ref name="DFRS" />

In addition to the lush tropical terrain, Rishi's surface featured mountains, valleys, and swamps. [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Alien/Legends|alien]] colonists lived in the deep valleys, while the Rishii lived in the high mountains.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was known for its rich fossil fuel resources, especially [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]].<ref name="Exonium">{{TORcite|type=codex|Exonium}}</ref>

==History==
===Old Republic era===
{{Quote|Nothing on Rishi but pirates and gunrunners.|[[Zenith]]|<ref name="SOR" />}}
Rishi was discovered more than a century before the [[Galactic War]] by a group of pirates, the [[Nova Blades]], when their [[Aggressor (Rishi)|starship]] crash-landed on the planet after a failed attempt to explore the Rishi Maze. Unable to leave Rishi, the Nova Blades settled on the planet and eventually learned to refine its fossil fuels. However, the Nova Blades later chose to stay on the planet and made Rishi a paradise for many criminals in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TSoR">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Settlement of Rishi}}</ref> While they initially did not bother the natives, who were greatly curious about them and their activities, a young Rishii named [[Arankau]] suspected they would eventually attack them. He studied their behavior and combat abilities, so when the Nova Blades eventually tried to attack, they were severally, but all non-fatally, wounded by an ambush consisting of dozen of Rishii. From then on, the Rishii were never bothered by outsiders.<ref name="Arankau">{{TORcite|type=codex|Arankau}}</ref>

During the Galactic War between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Rishi was the theater of the [[Battle of Rishi]] between the two powers and the [[Order of Revan]].<ref name="TOR:SoR" />

[[File:Rishi_Maze-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Rishi Maze seen from the surface of Rishi]]
In the leadup to the battle, eight individuals, each a hero of either the Republic or Empire, were drawn to Rishi: the [[Hero of Tython]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and slayer of [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]], the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]],<ref name="The Scars We Bear">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Scars We Bear|Rishi}}</ref> [[The Barsen'thor]], a member of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]],<ref name="Legacy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Jedi Consular|Barsen'thor's Legacy|Rishi}}</ref> the [[Voidhound]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had killed the notorious [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill|Harridax "The Voidwolf" Kirill]],<ref name="Tickets to Haven">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Smuggler|Tickets to Haven|Rishi}}</ref> [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Meteor]], the current leader of the elite [[Havoc Squad]], the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], the Sith Emperor's personal enforcer and executioner,<ref name="SoR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Sith Warrior|Vowrawn and the Wrath|Rishi}}</ref> [[Darth Nox]], a member of the [[Dark Council]],<ref name="Darkest Stars">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|exps=shadow|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Secrets of the Darkest Stars|Rishi}}</ref> a [[Hunter (individual)|hunter]], who had obtained the title of [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]],<ref name="Left Behind">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Ones Left Behind|Rishi}}</ref> and [[Cipher Nine]].<ref name="Forfeit">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Imperial Agent|Forfeit|Rishi}}</ref>

The Hero of Tython met with [[Orgus Din]], their late master, in the form of a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], in his childhood home on the planet. The deceased [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] gave his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] one final lesson, encouraging the Padawan, who had been immersed in death and warfare for so long, to help the people of Rishi and be reminded through good deeds what it truly means to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. To fullfill his Master's last wish, the Padawan and [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble]] cured homeless people of the [[Corellian Tanamen Fever]] for free. Having cleared rubble and repaired the monsoon baffles as well, Orgus revealed to his Padawan that the upcoming year will have a better wet season on Rishi.<ref name="The Scars We Bear" />

The Barsen'thor was contacted by [[Satele Shan]], who requested they construct a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to preserve their knowledge and insight. With the help of Jedi Master [[Kutri O'a]] and their Padawan [[Nadia Grell]], the [[Third Barsen'thor's holocron]] was successfully constructed.<ref name="Legacy" />

Ten Years after the Battle of Rishi, according to a [[Force vision]] experienced and shared by [[Orgus Din]], the people of Rishi chased away the pirates except for those that have settled down completely. And a century later, Rishi might have become a thriving planet with its locals living in harmony with life and nature.<ref name="The Scars We Bear" />

===Modern history===
{{Quote|There's only one target of interest in this sector: ''Kamino''. It's the closest thing we clones have to a home. Today we fight for more than the Republic. Today we fight for all our brothers back home.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], to [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]]|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
[[File:Rishi_mines_attack.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] and [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] warriors attack the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].]]
In [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> some 50,000 [[H'kig]] fundamentalist followers left the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] world of [[Galand]] and founded a religious colony on Rishi. However the group quickly dissolved in religious schism, with a minority who left the planet and settled another colony on [[J't'p'tan]].<ref name="JTaT" /> Many smugglers later used Rishi as a base because of the colonists' tolerance.<ref name="DFRS" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attempted to plunder Rishi's rich exonium mines. This [[Capture of Rishi|invasion]] was [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|repulsed]] by [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]], and the native Rishii.<ref name="TGoD" /> During the Clone Wars, there was a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]]. Because of its close proximity to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Rishi was considered a last defense of the clone-producing planet. This base was used to warn the Republic fleet of any CIS ships entering the area. The base was [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attacked]] by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his forces during the war. The station was destroyed by [[Hevy/Legends|CT-782]] when he sacrificed himself to alert the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], forcing the Separatist fleet to retreat.<ref name="Rookies" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]] and his lieutenant [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] had a [[Rishi Base (Talon Karrde)|base]] here, which became his main base of operations after his [[Myrkr Base|base]] at [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] was [[Rescue on Myrkr|compromised]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The base was quickly abandoned after the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gunner Groth]] discovered the presence of Karrde's smugglers on Rishi.<ref name="DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rishi_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Rishi as depicted in ''The Essential Atlas'']]
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Rishi in the Farfin sector (a misspelling of the true [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]]) of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
